# Weather coverage summary (generated by src/acquire/weather.py)

Source: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily .dly by-station files (see data/raw/weather/MANIFEST.csv).
Quality-flagged observations are treated as missing. Windows end the day before Election Day.
SNOW window = Aug 1 .. Election Day - 1. JJA = Jun 1 .. Aug 31.
`snow_window_complete` = every window day has a SNOW obs OR a >=0.1 in snowfall was found (existence of snow is then certain; the *date* of first snow is only certain if no earlier day is missing).

## Verdict (computed)
- JJA TMAX complete for all 32 election years: USW00094728, USC00190736
- Snow window (>=0.1 in) complete for all 32 years: USW00094728
- Snow window (>=1.0 in) complete for all 32 years: USW00094728
- Stations are never spliced. Cities with no single complete station: any city whose stations are absent from the lists above. A merge (e.g. Fort Dearborn -> O'Hare/Midway for Chicago, Washington -> Reagan) would need sourced move dates and is NOT applied.
- Caveat: SNOW >= 0.1 in uses >= 2.5 mm (GHCN stores whole mm); a stored 2 mm is excluded.
